hunks.baseline: Xining, the capital of Qinghai, was a city built on a vast plateau.
hunks.sol: Xining, the capital of Qinghai, stood on a vast plateau.

hunks.baseline: Tributaries of the Yellow River, which flowed east and west all the way to the Central Plains, ran through the region. Mountains large and small surrounded it on every side, giving it scenery beautiful enough to draw gasps from anyone who saw it.
hunks.sol: Tributaries of the Yellow River flowed to its east and west, stretching all the way to the Central Plains. Mountains large and small surrounded the city, making for a view beautiful enough to draw gasps from anyone who saw it.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t merely that they failed to see its beauty. They couldn’t.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t that they failed to appreciate it. They couldn’t.

hunks.baseline: The sight of a mountain that should have stood tall and still, as always, now in motion was enough to freeze the spine.
hunks.sol: A mountain that should have stood tall and still, as it always had, was moving. The sight alone was enough to send a chill down their spines.

hunks.baseline: The city shook with it. So did the people, body and soul.
hunks.sol: The whole city shook with it. So did its people, body and soul.

hunks.baseline: No—a force of enemies moving as one, like a mountain.
hunks.sol: No—an army moving like a single mountain.

hunks.baseline: Fiends from beyond the desert, come to blacken the blue sky and the green earth alike.
hunks.sol: Fiends from beyond the desert, come to blacken the blue sky and green earth alike.

hunks.baseline: The world had suddenly grown dark. I knew I wasn’t the only one who felt it.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t have been the only one who felt as though the world had suddenly grown dark.

hunks.baseline: Dark. In every direction.
hunks.sol: It was dark everywhere.

hunks.baseline: Dark clouds hid the sun, and a chill that seemed to swallow the sunlight filled the space it left behind.
hunks.sol: Clouds hid the sun, and a chill that swallowed its light filled the space it left behind.

hunks.baseline: And—
At the center of it all, they stood.
hunks.sol: And at the center of it all stood *them*.

hunks.baseline: Dark Heaven’s vast army, where monsters and humans mingled.
hunks.sol: Dark Heaven’s vast army of monsters and humans.

hunks.baseline: “……Benefactor.”
hunks.sol: “…Benefactor.”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung’s voice came from somewhere behind me on the wall. It was lower than usual, with the faintest tremor in it, but I didn’t answer.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung had come up onto the wall at some point. His voice was lower than usual, with a faint tremor in it, but I didn’t answer.

hunks.baseline: I, too, had been overwhelmed by the sight of the enemy filling the horizon beyond the wall as they advanced.
hunks.sol: I was overwhelmed, too, by the sight of the enemy advancing beyond the wall, filling everything in view.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t let anyone find out. Not ever.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t let anyone see that. Not ever.

hunks.baseline: I might have been able to fool the whole world, but there was one person I couldn’t fool.
hunks.sol: But even if I could fool the whole world, there was one person I couldn’t fool.

hunks.baseline: *Yes. I am.*
hunks.sol: Yes. I was.

hunks.baseline: I was terrified that their strength was far greater than I’d merely guessed up until now. That, the moment I saw what they truly were, my instincts had made me think of the word defeat.
hunks.sol: Their strength was far greater than I’d imagined. And the moment I saw them for what they truly were, the word *defeat* had come to me by instinct. That frightened me.

hunks.baseline: Squeeze.
hunks.sol: *Squeeze.*

hunks.baseline: I felt a warm sensation in my fist, clenched so tightly I hadn’t even realized it. I tightened it further, keeping the beads of blood from slipping between my fingers, and answered.
hunks.sol: Warmth spread through the fist I’d clenched without realizing it. I curled my fingers tighter to keep the beads of blood from slipping between them, and answered.

hunks.baseline: *—I’m most afraid of myself—of how I’ve shrunk back, even after making up my mind and preparing myself for this. And of what will happen because of it.*
hunks.sol: *—Myself, most of all. I made up my mind. I prepared for this. And I still shrank back. I’m afraid of what might happen because of that.*

hunks.baseline: I wouldn’t say I wasn’t afraid of dying.
hunks.sol: I wouldn’t claim I wasn’t afraid of dying.

hunks.baseline: That would be denying the person I’d been all this time, fighting tooth and nail just to survive. It would be a laughable lie.
hunks.sol: That would deny every desperate struggle I’d made to survive. It would be laughable hypocrisy.

hunks.baseline: But there was something I feared far more: the hundreds of thousands of lives behind the wall I stood on, vanishing.
hunks.sol: But I feared something far more: the hundreds of thousands of lives behind this wall being lost because I’d made the wrong choice.

hunks.baseline: Because of my own bad decision. No one else’s.
hunks.sol: Because of me, and no one else.

hunks.baseline: Before I could ask what he meant, his next Sound Transmission reached my ear.
hunks.sol: Before I could ask what he meant, his next Sound Transmission reached me.

hunks.baseline: *—I’ve never once pursued some grand cause in my life. I simply went where my feet took me, where the wind blew. So the deaths of strangers I’d never met didn’t trouble me much.*
hunks.sol: *—Not once in my life have I pursued some grand cause. I simply went where my feet took me, where the wind blew. The deaths of strangers I’d never met didn’t trouble me much.*

hunks.baseline: People saw Jeok Cheongang as the foremost of the Ten Kings, one of the towering figures representing the orthodox faction. But in truth, he was different.
hunks.sol: People saw Jeok Cheongang as the foremost of the Ten Kings, one of the great figures of the orthodox faction. But the truth was different.

hunks.baseline: *—Maybe that’s why the title of Great Hero, which stuck to me like a label before I knew it, always felt like an ill-fitting suit.*
hunks.sol: *—Perhaps that’s why the title of Great Hero, which stuck to me before I knew it, always felt like clothes that didn’t fit.*

hunks.baseline: *—No. That’s wrong.*
hunks.sol: *—No. You’re wrong.*

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang answered firmly and looked at me with deep, thoughtful eyes.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang answered firmly and fixed me with a deep, searching gaze.

hunks.baseline: *—Only those who fear the pain of others, and know how to shed tears, deserve to be called Great Heroes. Just like you.*
hunks.sol: *—Only someone who fears the pain of others and knows how to shed tears deserves to be called a Great Hero. Someone like you.*

hunks.baseline: *—But remember this one thing. If you don’t want to shed tears later, you have to overcome the fear right in front of you first.*
hunks.sol: *—But remember one thing. If you don’t want to shed tears later, you must first overcome the fear in front of you.*

hunks.baseline: Then Jeok Cheongang added in a low voice,
hunks.sol: Then Jeok Cheongang added quietly,

hunks.baseline: I mouthed those two words in my mind. They had always felt so far away. Then I gave a bitter smile.
hunks.sol: I turned that word over in my mind. It had always felt so far away. I gave a bitter smile.

hunks.baseline: *—I never wanted any of that.*
hunks.sol: *—I never wanted to be one.*

hunks.baseline: *—It doesn’t matter. You don’t become a hero just because you want to. You earn the title when the world calls you one.*
hunks.sol: *—That doesn’t matter. Wanting to be a hero isn’t what makes you one. You earn the title when the world calls you one.*

hunks.baseline: *—You just said it yourself. You didn’t go out of your way to pursue some grand cause. You just went where your feet took you, where the wind blew—and before you knew it, people were calling you a Great Hero.*
hunks.sol: *—You just said it yourself. You never went out of your way to pursue a grand cause. You went where your feet took you, where the wind blew—and before you knew it, people were calling you a Great Hero.*

hunks.baseline: *—You haven’t lost your knack for running that mouth. Now you’re finally starting to feel like the little hellion I knew.*
hunks.sol: *—You haven’t lost your knack for running that mouth. Now you’re finally starting to sound like the little hellion I knew.*

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang let out a quiet laugh and gestured with his chin toward the other side of the wall.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang let out a quiet laugh and gestured with his chin beyond the wall.

hunks.baseline: *—But I won’t try to look away from that fear.*
hunks.sol: *—But I won’t look away from that fear.*

hunks.baseline: Everyone carries some fear in a corner of their heart.
hunks.sol: Everyone carries fear somewhere in their heart.

hunks.baseline: But only those who admit it and face it head-on can find the strength to stand up to it.
hunks.sol: But only those who admit it and face it head-on can find the strength to stand against it.

hunks.baseline: Just as I was now.
hunks.sol: Just as I was doing now.

hunks.baseline: I felt the powerful vibrations climb through my whole body as they traveled up the tall, sturdy wall.
hunks.sol: I felt the powerful vibrations travel up the tall, sturdy wall and through my whole body.

hunks.baseline: And at the same time, I saw him.
hunks.sol: At the same time, I saw him.

hunks.baseline: At the head of the enemy forces, so numerous I couldn’t begin to count them, one man was grinning as he looked straight at us.
hunks.sol: At the head of an enemy force too vast to count by sight, one man was grinning straight at me.

hunks.baseline: He looked quite different from the last time I’d seen him, but the moment I saw that crooked smile, I knew by instinct.
hunks.sol: He looked quite different from the last time I’d seen him, but the moment I saw that crooked smile, I knew.

hunks.baseline: That thick, viscous killing intent and madness, so palpable it seemed like you’d get it on your hand if you touched him, outstripped even the Blood-Sword Demon Lord I’d taken down in Gansu.
hunks.sol: The thick killing intent and madness about him seemed as though they’d rub off if I touched him. Even the Blood-Sword Demon Lord I’d defeated in Gansu couldn’t compare.

hunks.baseline: “My body was getting restless anyway. He’s doing me the favor of scratching the itch.”
hunks.sol: “I was itching for a fight anyway. How kind of him to offer.”

hunks.baseline: Bow Saint immediately sensed the danger and tried to stop him.
hunks.sol: The Bow Saint immediately sensed what was coming and tried to stop him.

hunks.baseline: “It’s goading you. Obvious as can be.”
hunks.sol: “He’s baiting you. It couldn’t be more obvious.”

hunks.baseline: At her expectant glance, the Slaughter Saint, who had appeared out of nowhere at some point and taken up a place on the wall, calmly nodded.
hunks.sol: At her look for support, the Slaughter Saint, who had appeared out of nowhere and taken up a place on the wall, calmly nodded.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah, it’s crazy.”
hunks.sol: “It would be crazy.”

hunks.baseline: Then, as Jeok Cheongang furrowed his brow, the Slaughter Saint added,
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang furrowed his brow. The Slaughter Saint added,

hunks.baseline: “But it’s not like anyone here is thinking straight.”
hunks.sol: “Then again, no one here is in their right mind.”

hunks.baseline: My expression solemn, I drew the obvious conclusion.
hunks.sol: As Jeok Cheongang’s brow smoothed, I delivered my solemn verdict.

hunks.baseline: Reciting the number-one last words of men everywhere, the three of us sprang off the wall at the same time.
hunks.sol: Reciting the number-one last words of men everywhere, the three of us sprang off the wall together.

hunks.baseline: Behind us came the sharpest, loudest shout I’d ever heard from Bow Saint.
hunks.sol: Behind us came the sharpest, loudest shout I’d ever heard from the Bow Saint.

hunks.baseline: “I said don’t go!”
hunks.sol: “I told you not to go!”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord watched three figures plummet across the distant sky in an instant. Without thinking, he muttered,
hunks.sol: The moment he saw three figures hurtling across the distant sky toward him, the Blood Lord muttered without realizing it,

hunks.baseline: “They’re crazy. They’re really coming?”
hunks.sol: “They’re crazy. They’re actually coming?”

hunks.baseline: He’d only tossed out a casual remark. They’d traded a few words, and now the three of them were charging straight at him without the slightest hesitation.
hunks.sol: He’d only tossed out a casual remark. After a few words between them, he hadn’t expected them to charge straight at him without a moment’s hesitation.

hunks.baseline: “Like half-mad fighting dogs or something…”
hunks.sol: “What are they, half-mad fighting dogs…?”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord trailed off, considerably taken aback. Then the three men—now over thirty yards away, moving like flashes of light—spoke at once.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord trailed off, more than a little taken aback. By then, the three men had closed to a dozen or so zhang, moving like flashes of light. They spoke at once.

hunks.baseline: “You worthless bastard. You goddamn bastard. You piece of shit. You’re the kind of bastard I’d burn alive and still not be satisfied—”
hunks.sol: “You’re lower than a dog. You goddamned bastard. Burning you alive wouldn’t be enough, you miserable—”

hunks.baseline: “So you’re the Blood Lord I’ve heard about. I know this is a strange request for a first meeting, but would you mind calmly offering your neck and stepping aside?”
hunks.sol: “So you’re the Blood Lord I’ve heard about. An odd request when we’ve only just met, I know, but would you consider quietly handing over your head and stepping aside?”

hunks.baseline: First came Jin Taekyung, whose curses had an oddly satisfying ring to them. Then Jeok Cheongang, hurling every obscenity he knew. And finally the Slaughter Saint, whom the Blood Lord was meeting for the first time.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung’s curses had an oddly satisfying ring to them. Jeok Cheongang hurled every obscenity he knew. Even the Slaughter Saint, whom the Blood Lord was meeting for the first time, joined in.

hunks.baseline: For a moment, surprise had covered the Blood Lord’s anger. Now he felt it surge back to the surface.
hunks.sol: The anger that his surprise had briefly obscured surged to the surface.

hunks.baseline: At the Blood Lord’s low voice, Jin Taekyung hesitated briefly and glanced at the Slaughter Saint.
hunks.sol: At the Blood Lord’s low voice, Jin Taekyung paused and glanced at the Slaughter Saint.

hunks.baseline: “Do you have anything else to say?”
hunks.sol: “Anything else you’d like to say?”

hunks.baseline: The Slaughter Saint had already been remarkably rude for someone who’d just met him. Jin Taekyung nodded as if it were nothing, then answered the Blood Lord.
hunks.sol: The Slaughter Saint had already been remarkably rude for someone meeting him for the first time, but Jin Taekyung merely nodded and answered the Blood Lord.

hunks.baseline: “He says he’s done.”
hunks.sol: “This one says he’s done.”

hunks.baseline: Crack.
hunks.sol: *Grit.*

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord gritted his teeth and opened his mouth at that nonchalant response.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord clenched his teeth at that nonchalant response and opened his mouth.

hunks.baseline: Before he could, another wave of obscenities swept over him.
hunks.sol: Before he could, another wave of abuse swept over him.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll grind every bone in your body to dust. I’ll toss your flesh to the Nanman Beast Palace to feed their beasts, and scatter your bones in the Shaolin Temple latrines, and—”
hunks.sol: “I’ll grind down every last bone in your body. I’ll toss your flesh to the Nanman Beast Palace for feed, then scatter your remains in the Shaolin Temple latrines, and—”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, this one isn’t done yet. Wait a bit. Honestly, aren’t you kind of curious what comes next?”
hunks.sol: “Ah, this one isn’t done yet. Give him a moment. Honestly, aren’t you a little curious what comes next?”

hunks.baseline: A powerful wave of energy swept out in every direction.
hunks.sol: A powerful wave of qi swept out in every direction.

hunks.baseline: The immense internal energy packed into that single shout made Dark Heaven’s army, which had seemed as though it would march on without end, and the people on the wall over three hundred yards away, all hold their breath.
hunks.sol: The immense internal energy packed into that single shout made Dark Heaven’s seemingly endless army and the people on the wall a hundred or so zhang away hold their breath.

hunks.baseline: But the three men closest to him, who felt the full force of that wave, were the exception.
hunks.sol: But the three men closest to him, who felt the full force of it, were the exception.

hunks.baseline: Whoosh!
hunks.sol: *Whoosh!*

hunks.baseline: A single sharp gust cut through the dust that had billowed into the air.
hunks.sol: A single sharp gust cut through the billowing dust.

hunks.baseline: At its center, Jin Taekyung had already brought his clear, almost transparent spearhead slashing down. He grinned.
hunks.sol: At its center, Jin Taekyung had already slashed down with his clear, almost transparent spearhead. He grinned.

hunks.baseline: An explosion meant destruction, but it was also tied to erasure.
hunks.sol: An explosion meant destruction. Destruction, in turn, was bound up with Erasure.

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord had drawn his anger together and unleashed it all at once. Now he stared at Jin Taekyung with eyes gone cold.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord had gathered his anger and unleashed it all at once. Now he stared at Jin Taekyung with eyes gone cold.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, the smile on Jin Taekyung’s lips disappeared.
hunks.sol: The smile vanished from Jin Taekyung’s lips.

hunks.baseline: “This time will be different. Everything else will be.”
hunks.sol: “Everything else will be different this time.”
